    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    checkConfigurationArray()
    Verifies that the machine configuration starts as an empty array when there are no symbols.
    void
    checkDistinctSymbols()
    Verifies that the count of distinct symbols correctly ignores repeated symbols placed on different wheels.
    void
    checkReturnsASymbolsList()
    Verifies that the symbols list starts as an empty array when no symbols have been added.
    void
    checkSymbolIsNotDuplicated()
    Verifies that adding the same symbol twice for the same wheel sets the machine status to not ok, since duplicated symbols are not allowed.
    void
    setUp()
    Sets up the test case.
    void
    shouldAddSymbol()
    Verifies that a symbol can be added both when the wheels list is empty and after wheels have been added, keeping the machine status ok.
    void
    shouldAddWheelInAInvalidPos()
    Verifies that attempting to add a wheel at an invalid position still leaves the machine status as ok.
    void
    shouldAddWheelInAValidPos()
    Verifies that a wheel can be added at a valid position and that the machine status remains ok.
    void
    shouldBeJackpot()
    Verifies that spinning all wheels when they share the same symbol results in a jackpot, keeping the machine status ok.
    void
    shouldDeleteSymbol()
    Verifies that existing symbols can be deleted correctly, leaving the machine status ok and the symbols array with the expected size.
    void
    shouldDelWheel()
    Verifies that an existing wheel can be successfully deleted, leaving the machine status as ok.
    void
    shouldFailWhenDeletingNonexistentSymbol()
    Verifies that deleting a symbol that was never added fails, setting the machine status to not ok.
    void
    shouldHandlePositionAdjustmentsInOperations()
    Verifies that out-of-range positions passed to placeSymbol are adjusted to the nearest valid index (zero for positions below range, the last index for positions above range), keeping the machine status ok.
    void
    shouldNotAddWheelWhenLimitExcedeed()
    Verifies that once the maximum number of wheels (MAX_COLUMNS * MAX_ROWS) has been reached, adding an additional wheel fails and sets the machine status to not ok.
    void
    shouldNotBeJackpot()
    Verifies that an empty machine is never considered a jackpot.
    void
    shouldNotDeleteASingleSymbol()
    Verifies that deleting a symbol when it is the only one present fails, setting the machine status to not ok.
    void
    shouldNotDeleteIfNoSymbols()
    Verifies that deleting a nonexistent symbol sets the machine status to not ok.
    void
    shouldNotDelWheel()
    Verifies that trying to delete a wheel that doesn't exist sets the machine status to not ok.
    void
    shouldNotSpinAnyWheel()
    Verifies that spinning fails when there are no wheels or symbols, setting the machine status to not ok.
    void
    shouldReturnOrderedConfigurationOfWheels()
    Verifies that placing a specific symbol on each wheel results in the configuration array matching the expected order.
    void
    shouldSetOkToTrueWhenChangingVisibility()
    Verifies that toggling the machine's visibility (visible/invisible) always leaves the machine status as ok.
    void
    shouldSpinAInvalidPosWheel()
    Verifies that spinning a wheel at an invalid position adjusts the position to the first wheel and still updates its symbol, keeping the machine status ok.
    void
    shouldSpinAWheel()
    Verifies that spinning a wheel at a valid position changes its visible symbol and keeps the machine status ok.
    void
    tearDown()
    Tears down the test case.
